command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged input against its pinned sha256 =="
printf '%s  %s\n' b4d4d74594d6213f26dfbd8eeb194ae9a9eaf6c529242384a7395bb56c7c7294 \
  pfam38.2_seed_alignment.fa > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== iqtree3: maximum-likelihood tree, LG+G4, fixed seed =="
# -T 4, not AUTO: the number of threads changes the order of likelihood updates and
# therefore which local optimum the search lands in, so a fixed thread count plus a
# fixed seed is what makes this run comparable to the next one. -m is given
# explicitly rather than letting ModelFinder choose, for the same reason.
iqtree3 -s pfam38.2_seed_alignment.fa -m LG+G4 -T 4 --seed 12345 --prefix iqout -redo

# ---- smoke check ----
# The shape checks are exact: taxon and column counts come straight from the pinned
# alignment, and every tip must appear in the tree. The log-likelihood is BANDED,
# and deliberately wide: heuristic tree search is not reproducible across IQ-TREE
# versions or thread counts even with a fixed seed, so a tight bound here would be
# a check that fails for uninteresting reasons. The band's job is to catch a tree
# built from garbage — a mis-parsed alignment or an all-gap column block lands
# nowhere near it.
NTAX_IN=$(grep -c '^>' pfam38.2_seed_alignment.fa)
NTAX_TREE=$(grep -oE '[(,][A-Za-z0-9_]+:' iqout.treefile | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
COLS=$(awk '/sequences with/ {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /^columns/) {print $(i-1); exit}}' iqout.log)
LOGL=$(awk '/^BEST SCORE FOUND/ {print $NF}' iqout.log)
TERMINATED=$(tail -n 5 iqout.log | grep -c 'Date and Time' || true)
SEMICOLON=$(tail -c 2 iqout.treefile | tr -d '\n')

{
  echo "taxa_in_alignment   $NTAX_IN     want exactly 114"
  echo "tips_in_tree        $NTAX_TREE   want exactly 114"
  echo "alignment_columns   $COLS        want exactly 477"
  echo "best_log_likelihood $LOGL        want -54000..-52000  (observed -52706.731)"
  echo "newick_terminated   $SEMICOLON   want exactly ;"
  echo "iqtree_wrote_footer $TERMINATED  want exactly 1"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$NTAX_IN"     -eq 114
test "$NTAX_TREE"   -eq 114
test "$COLS"        -eq 477
test "$SEMICOLON"    = ";"
test "$TERMINATED"  -eq 1
test -s iqout.treefile
# Log-likelihoods are negative reals, so compare in awk, not test(1).
awk -v l="$LOGL" 'BEGIN{ if (l > -54000 && l < -52000) exit 0; print "log-likelihood " l " outside band"; exit 1 }'
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
